paragraphs: The xDrive50i was the V8 flagship of the X6 range during the F16 generation (2014–2019), using BMW's N63 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 from the "hot-vee" engine family. The N63 places the turbochargers within the V of the engine, a layout that's been well-documented across BMW V8s of this era for its specific thermal and wear patterns. The xDrive50i was replaced in the current G06 generation by the M60i, which uses a different V8 engine code that's still being confirmed for this model. The X6 xDrive50i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the X6 spans several distinct engines across two generations (F16 and G06), fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming parts from one generation will work on another — risks a compatibility problem. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
